items.title: Trump tells APEC he opposes strict rules on superintelligence
items.summary: Speaking at the summit in Shenzhen, Trump argued heavy regulation would hold back advanced AI, days after new US limits on Chinese remote access to top AI chips.

items.title: Nvidia stops shipping H200 chips to China
items.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress told investors Nvidia has halted licensed Hopper-generation chip shipments to China with no plans to resume, as Beijing also restricts imports.

items.title: Students and professors push back on campus AI deals
items.summary: A growing number of US students and faculty are refusing generative AI and petitioning colleges to drop AI spending, citing worries about weakened critical thinking.

items.title: New AI companion laws may reach classroom chatbots
items.summary: At a California edtech conference, experts warned that state companion-chatbot laws, which limit memory and session length for kids, may not exempt K-12 learning tools.

items.title: Austin ISD adopts its first AI policy
items.summary: Students may use only district-approved AI tools with teacher permission, and the district has 18 months to write detailed rules for students, teachers and staff.

items.title: UN rights chief calls AI governance outdated and concentrated
items.summary: Volker Türk said a handful of tech firms control most global AI computing power and urged rights-based regulation and stronger safeguards from frontier labs.
